title: Surreal Dream Bridge
description: A hooded figure with glowing golden particles emanating from their head stands on a cracked stone bridge holding a staff. The scene features multiple floating islands with mirrors reflecting the same cloaked figure, a large melting clock, classical statues, a glowing book, and a winding colorful river flowing through a dark starry night sky.
prompt: A mysterious hooded figure in a dark flowing cloak stands on an ancient cracked stone bridge, holding a glowing staff while emitting golden sparkling particles from their head. Multiple floating grassy islands in a dark starry night sky contain ornate mirrors reflecting the same figure, classical white statues surrounded by white flowers, a giant melting clock with Roman numerals, and a dark twisted tree. A colorful flowing river winds between the islands as an open magical book rests on the bridge, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, intricate details, cinematic lighting.
